plain_description.what: Checks whether the Multi-SWE-bench agent trajectories contain any language-and-repository group with at least 120 evaluation tasks under the split rules, and whether the agent's step cap can be recovered. Data download only, no LLM calls.
plain_description.why: It decides whether this agent corpus can support a per-cell agent profile or only a description.
plain_description.information: A group of 120 or more would allow an agent profile cell. Result: done. No group reaches 120 on the evaluation side (all large repos fell on the training side), so agents stay description-only on this corpus under this split. The step cap was fully recovered: 50 steps. There are no agent capability numbers and no cross-scaffold comparison.
